title: East Nash House: Inglewood*Entire* Cottage*Hot tub
description:
Enjoy a stylish experience at this centrally-located place in the heart of everything East Nashville has to offer! Close to both the airport and downtown (15 min) while being far enough away to sleep soundly.  House is equipped with full kitchen, washer, dryer, grill, easy parking, gym equipment, HOT TUB, & 3 beds (one twin, one full, one queen). Short term rental permit in photos. This is my primary residence that I host out while traveling, so the entire home is privately yours when you book!

The space
3 bedroom, 1 bath with private outdoor fenced in deck. You have access to the entire home that I rent out while traveling so complete privacy will be yours with an easy check in and out process. The kitchen is fully stocked in case you prefer to stay in and cook. Bathroom also has all the essentials, and gym equipment available in the laundry room. Enjoy!

Other things to note
No parties allowed!
